'''Desnoy NMNPND (v1.00)''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Desnoy]]
* '''Published:''' 1 May 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|No Money, No Parts, No Deal!|Cor-D-nomoneynopartsnodeal.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' No Money, No Parts, No Deal!
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 NMNPND Desnoy DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is my new NMNPND deck, im trying to make a solid deck so every comment will be good, thank in advance ( I take inspiration from lot of deck )
